items.title: Godot to ban (almost all) AI coding contributions
items.excerpt: The open-source Godot game engine is updating its contribution policy to ban the use of AI to generate substantial pieces of code, drawing a hard line on how AI-assisted work is allowed into the engine's codebase. A concrete governance decision that shapes how thousands of contributors are permitted to build with (and without) AI.
